note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. Substituting a datum of the side note never changes the source text and states no legal effect.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: The pinpoint of R. Ferrer’s card changes from ¶2 to ¶3: inside the lens the thread’s pin is pulled and re-pinned at ¶3, the bracket moves and the old bracket stays as a dashed trace; the context follows on return.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: the datum is the attribution of the note (R. Ferrer → L. Vidal); the lens isolates the card’s attribution band and the thread and pinpoint stay exactly where they were.

contextLabels.context: Side note pinned beside art. 7, attributed on its band

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long pinpoint labels, long context caption and marker, long source and commentary text; the pinpoint moves from ¶1 to the next passage, ¶2 (adjacent passages keep the lens squarish, so the long passage lines stay legible in it).

sources.sourceTitle: Article 7 — Notices, communications and addresses of the parties
passages: Each party names in writing a postal address and an electronic address for notices.
Notice is given in writing, is signed by the sender and states the date on which it is sent.
The sender keeps a copy of every notice together with any proof of dispatch.
sources.commentaryWork: Annotated Notes on the Example Code of Obligations
sources.commentaryText: Reads the words “in writing” in this passage as also covering email messages that identify the sender.

contextLabels.context: Commentator’s side note pinned beside article 7, tied by a thread to a passage
contextLabels.marker: Pinpoint of the side note changed

passages: Cada parte indica una dirección para avisos.
El aviso se da por escrito e indica la fecha de envío.
Quien envía el aviso conserva una copia.
sources.commentaryText: Entiende que «por escrito» incluye aquí el correo electrónico.
